options.text: The S-S-S bond angles in the <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>8</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub></math> rings are the same.
Rhombic and monoclinic Sulphur have <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>8</mn></mrow></msub></math> molecules.

solution.text:
Sulphur  have puckered  S8  rings with crown conformation, and S6  rings arranged in a chair conformation.


1) S-S-S bond angles in S 8 and S 6 rings are different

2) Rhombic & monoclinic are S 8 molecules but the arrangement of the molecules in space are different.

3) S 2 & O 2 both are paramagnetic according to MOT
